decisions.reason: As a close-to-core upholstery fabric with dedicated presentation and another year without negative signals, it remains a low-cost option whose value now looks more likely to be realized than abandoned.

This decorative fabric still fits the core assortment and is inexpensive to retain, but its lighter website support after two years keeps it under moderate review rather than justifying an immediate withdrawal.
Its flame-retardant functionality is well aligned with the firm's contract and hospitality strengths, so the option value remains high and the case for dropping it is weak.

After two years, the niche semi-transparent wool bouclé leno concept still appears weakly supported and less compelling against resource needs and the firm's cleaner sustainability direction, so the option should be abandoned.
As a very recently launched, close-to-core fabric with its own page, it is still in the uncertainty-resolution phase and cheap enough to keep while market feedback develops.
